name: hud_sensor_set_mission_id
description: HudSensorTracker::SetMissionId stores the mission id, clears the cached ZBD path for nonzero missions, and returns one. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly and decompilation at 0x4177a0 show missionId stored at offset 0xdc, CString::Empty called for zbdPath at offset 0xe8 when the new mission id is nonzero, and return value one.
CString::Empty is an MFC provider boundary and is dependency-ready for this setter contract.
The native mission-identity smoke verifies SetMissionId returns one, updates missionId as observed through GetMissionId, and clears an existing ZBD path for a nonzero mission id.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x4177a0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
